transitions.trigger: the agent runs the spawn script for an item it judged ready
transitions.guard: item unheld and unblocked; places-held below the declared capacity when one is declared; an isolated worktree resolved

transitions.trigger: the spawn script finds every capacity place held
transitions.guard: places-held at or above the declared capacity
transitions.failure: capacity full (exit 75); lock contention or an unreadable capacity declaration refuses with exit 1 and does not wait

changes: places-held falls when another worker records its ready PR or is cleaned up

transitions.trigger: the worker reports a PR or a ready branch
transitions.guard: the named head is reachable outside the worker's disposable copy

transitions.trigger: the merge lands and the agent runs the teardown script; the captain approves the merge, or with yolo on firstmate merges green work itself, and a local-only ship lands by a guarded fast-forward
transitions.guard: worktree clean and committed work landed; a local-only project also counts work merged into the local default branch, and a merge made under yolo may leave no recorded PR

transitions.trigger: the backlog close fails during teardown
the next session start replays the pending-close record
transitions.guard: the pending-close record passes the shared validator

transitions.trigger: a replay of the pending close ends incomplete
a stale wake shows the worker stopped, looping or unresponsive
transitions.failure: worker stale; a failed relaunch restores the prior durable record and reports that no agent is running

changes: the running agent is replaced in the same worktree
a progress note is appended to the instructions

transitions.trigger: the agent runs the teardown script while the backlog item is still an open captain call
transitions.guard: the item reads as an open captain call; if teardown cannot tell, it refuses before any destructive step and --force does not lift that

transitions.trigger: yolo is on and the work is green and in scope, so firstmate merges it itself
transitions.guard: the merge script's pre-merge conditions hold, read live; a red PR or a required check that has not reported is never merged

transitions.trigger: a scout's report exists at data/<id>/report.md and the agent runs the teardown script
transitions.guard: the report exists and its captain-held inventory is verified; the landed-work check does not apply to a scout

failures.name: no session start ever follows a failed close, so the pending close is never replayed

shared_resources: one home's backlog and task records
a secondmate's home and the crewmate records inside it
serialized_by: one project lock per machine-local firstmate tree, taken for allocation and return
concurrency.on_conflict: lock contention: the spawn exits 1 and does not wait; capacity full: the spawn exits 75 and the item stays queued; a normal secondmate teardown refuses while its home has in-flight crewmate records

touchpoints.no_answer: none found: the cited text sets no deadline or default for a captain who does not answer; with yolo on, firstmate merges green work without asking
